# raider-trace v1 fixture

`trace.zip` is a real trace, from a failing RSpec example in a generated Selenium project on headless Chrome. `unzipped/` holds the same entries, extracted.

- Generated by ruby_raider at `38416ff915cfcde514c72788f02ceac8855a823f` (branch `feat/trace-capture`, "Require cgi/escape, not cgi, in the trace helper"), after the final-review fix wave. Locators carry no `label`.
- Browser: Google Chrome 156.0.8078.74 (headless), macOS arm64. Reporter: raider_reporter 0.12.0 from RubyGems.
- Producer: `spec/integration/end_to_end_spec.rb`, example "Trace replay Selenium + RSpec on headless Chrome attaches one trace.zip to the failing example only...", run with `TRACE_FIXTURE_DIR` set.
- Page: served by `spec/integration/trace_page_server.rb` on 127.0.0.1, at a random port, so URLs in the trace name that port.

What it contains:
- a `navigate` step;
- `send_keys` steps into a password field and an `autocomplete="current-password"` text field, both with `value: null, secret: true`;
- a plain `send_keys` step and a `click`;
- two `eventually` groups, the second failed;
- BiDi JPEG screenshots and sanitised snapshots, with inlined CSS and no script;
- network entries (`/`, `/style.css`, and `/api`, which took about 300 ms);
- one console error.
